method.measurement: UTF-8 bytes of Node JSON.stringify(parsed JSON/YAML), no indentation; nodes count containers and scalar values once; properties count object entries; depth counts nested containers with root=1; keys and strings measured in UTF-8 bytes; traversalWorkUnits=nodes+properties.
method.corpusDigest: SHA-256 of sorted concatenation: relativePath + NUL + sha256(rawFileBytes) + LF. File ordering follows git ls-files sorted lexicographically.
limitations: Checked-in fixture/template measurements only; not real-user telemetry or a product-size distribution.
AST object-key references identify inspection coverage, not proof every key is emitted. Dedicated emitter mappings and context review remain authoritative.
Legacy fixtures can contain data deliberately permitted by broad validators; measuring them does not approve it for strict new authoring.

NEW_ENVELOPE_BYTES.scope: Allowed outer command metadata, excluding payload; reject unknown fields

NEW_BATCH_BYTES.scope: New-authoring request only; Complete canonical encoded batch including wrappers and outer metadata. Never use as a limit on replayCommands chunks, storage pages, or aggregated history.

NEW_BATCH_COMMANDS.scope: New-authoring request only; Whole submitted logical batch before any persistence. Never use as a limit on replayCommands chunks, storage pages, or aggregated history.

NEW_STRING_BYTES.scope: Each JSON string value unless narrower field contract

NEW_KEY_BYTES.scope: Each own JSON object key; dangerous path-segment policy additionally applies

NEW_ARRAY_ITEMS.scope: Every generic JSON array unless narrower field contract

NEW_OBJECT_KEYS.scope: Every generic JSON object/dictionary unless narrower field contract

NEW_JSON_DEPTH.scope: Canonical wrapper counts as depth1; scalar leaves add no container level

NEW_ACTION_DEPTH.scope: Root action map depth1; callback/branch/choice/form action maps increment

NEW_EXPRESSION_BYTES.scope: Each authored expression string or canonical structured condition/expression JSON

NEW_EXPRESSION_DEPTH.scope: Each parsed or semantic JSON expression; root1

NEW_EXPRESSION_NODES.scope: Each expression including operands and operators

NEW_AUDIO_ITEMS.scope: Each bgm/voice/sfx sounds or legacy items array; batch work/bytes apply to total

NEW_SHADER_FILTERS.scope: Built-in filter definitions only; distinct allowed ids

NEW_MODEL_PAYLOAD_BYTES.scope: Pure model canonical domain command.payload; no transport wrapper knowledge. Applies per recorded strict command.

NEW_MODEL_PROJECT_PAYLOAD_BYTES.scope: Pure model canonical domain project.create payload including state; replaces ordinary domain cap.

NEW_MODEL_JSON_DEPTH.scope: Pure model domain payload root is depth1; allows one extra wrapper container within client NEW_JSON_DEPTH128.

HISTORY_PAGE_RECORDS.scope: Target maximum records requested per historical page

HISTORY_PAGE_BYTES.scope: Target page working-set bytes; a larger single row is processed alone without rejection solely due to page size

HISTORY_SLICE_MS.scope: Cooperative scheduling target between parse/replay traversal chunks; not a validation acceptance timeout

HISTORY_LARGE_RECORD_BYTES.scope: Use isolated large-record path/worker when exceeded; does not change recorded validity

HISTORY_PROGRESS_RECORDS.scope: Publish progress at each page; no total history count/bytes/depth validity cap added to envelope1

workBudgetDefinition: Deterministic score per command: input JSON value/property count + effective strict-result JSON value/property count + expression AST node count + declared indexed reference checks. Count each logical occurrence once in its input/result pass; structures shared across commands count per command. Versioned affected-result scope defines the result scored. Incidental helper calls, caching, or repeated implementation visits do not alter the score. Compatible validation/index construction over pre-existing state uses historical scheduling and never retroactively applies new-input caps. Implementation algorithms must have bounded actual work; cancellation is not invalid schema. New-authoring request batch work is sum of sequential command scores; historical replay checks each recorded strict command independently and does not impose a batch aggregate acceptance cap.
inventoryScopeNote: All commandLine component emitters (dedicated+runtime modes), shipped templates, all model compatibility archives, all engine YAML schemas, plus reviewed generic edit/export/extension boundaries. Not all engine action names are approved Creator actions. See action-contracts.md for strict support decisions. UI form-config .actions fields are not story action maps.

broadSourceScan.scope: All git-tracked src/**/*.js parsed with @babel/parser, modules; static assignments/deletions through actions/actionsObject/lineActions plus calls of shared action normalizers. Source symbols can also name UI form configuration, so this is audit coverage, not an inferred schema allowlist.
